mapper.select:
SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID,
D.DELIVERY_ID, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.TRACKING_NO,
OI.ITEM_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, B.BRAND_NAME AS BRAND_NAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS ITEM_COUNT, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE,
(SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY PI.IS_MAIN DESC LIMIT 1) AS IMG_URL
FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND B ON P.BRAND_ID = B.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOT (O.ORDER_STATUS = 'READY' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAYMENT P WHERE P.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND P.PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' )) ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC, OI.ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_CANCEL ( CANCEL_REASON_CODE, CANCEL_REASON_TEXT, CANCEL_AMOUNT, CANCEL_STATUS, REQUESTED_AT, ORDER_ID ) VALUES ( #{cancelReasonCode}, #{cancelReasonText}, #{cancelAmount}, 'REQUESTED', NOW(), #{orderId} )
mapper.select: SELECT DELIVERY_ID FROM DELIVERY WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, DATE_FORMAT(O.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, O.GUEST_NAME, O.GUEST_PHONE,
(SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ORDER BY OI.ITEM_ID ASC LIMIT 1) AS firstProductName,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI2 WHERE OI2.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID) AS itemCount,
(SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM ORDER_ITEM OI3 JOIN PRODUCT P2 ON OI3.PRODUCT_ID = P2.PRODUCT_ID JOIN PRODUCT_IMG PI ON PI.PRODUCT_ID = P2.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE OI3.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ORDER BY OI3.ITEM_ID ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumbUrl
FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN PAYMENT PAY ON PAY.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED')
WHERE O.USER_ID LIKE 'GUEST_%' AND O.GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND O.GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND ( PAY.PAY_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') OR O.ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' )
ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT OI.PRODUCT_ID, OI.OPTION_ITEM_ID, OI.QUANTITY, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE, O.ORDER_TYPE FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, USE_POINT, ORDER_TYPE, TOTAL_PRICE, ORDER_STATUS FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, DESCRIPTION, AMOUNT, TYPE, CREATED_AT, BALANCE_AFTER ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{description}, #{usePoint}, 'RESTORE', NOW(), (SELECT COALESCE(POINT, 0) + #{usePoint} FROM USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) )

INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, DESCRIPTION, AMOUNT, TYPE, CREATED_AT, BALANCE_AFTER ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{description}, #{earnedPoint}, 'CANCEL', NOW(), (SELECT COALESCE(POINT, 0) - #{earnedPoint} FROM USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) )
